content.text:
**No.** `CatalogApi.CreateItem` does not publish `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` — it publishes no integration events at all.

What `CreateItem` actually does (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:366-388`), in order:

1. Takes `[AsParameters] CatalogServices services` and a `CatalogItem product` from the request body (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:366-368`).
2. Constructs a **new** `CatalogItem` from the posted product, copying `Id`, `CatalogBrandId`, `CatalogTypeId`, `Description`, `PictureFileName`, `Price`, `AvailableStock`, `RestockThreshold`, and `MaxStockThreshold` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:370-381`). Note it does **not** copy `OnReorder`.
3. Computes and assigns an AI embedding via `services.CatalogAI.GetEmbeddingAsync(item)` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:382`).
4. Adds the item to `services.Context.CatalogItems` and calls `SaveChangesAsync()` directly on the DbContext — not the transactional `EventService` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:384-385`).
5. Returns `TypedResults.Created($"/api/catalog/items/{item.Id}")` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:387`).

It is registered as `POST /items` with the endpoint name `CreateItem` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:103-104`), and is annotated `[ProducesResponseType<ProblemDetails>(400)]` even though its return type is only `Task<Created>` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:365-366`).

How I established the "no": the only construction/publication of `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` anywhere in the Catalog service is in `UpdateItem`, guarded by `if (priceEntry.IsModified)`, where it is saved via `services.EventService.SaveEventAndCatalogContextChangesAsync` and then published with `PublishThroughEventBusAsync` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:345-357`). A repository-wide search for `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` returned only that one usage plus the event record definitions (`src/Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/Events/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent.cs:6`, `src/Webhooks.API/IntegrationEvents/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent.cs:3`) and the Webhooks subscriber side (`src/Webhooks.API/IntegrationEvents/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3`, `src/Webhooks.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:21`).

One caveat: `CreateItem` does not call `UpdateItem`, so there is no indirect path to that publish either — the two are separate endpoints, and only `UpdateItemDeprecated` delegates to `UpdateItem` (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:321`).
